title: Commercial Divers
description: Work below surface of water, using surface-supplied air or scuba equipment to inspect, repair, remove, or install equipment and structures. May use a variety of power and hand tools, such as drills, sledgehammers, torches, and welding equipment. May conduct tests or experiments, rig explosives, or photograph structures or marine life.

tasks.text: Check and maintain diving equipment, such as helmets, masks, air tanks, harnesses, or gauges.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Cleaning parts for repair needs hands-on dexterity

dwas.name: Clean equipment, parts, or tools to repair or maintain them in good working order.
Maintain work equipment or machinery.

tasks.text: Take appropriate safety precautions, such as monitoring dive lengths and depths and registering with authorities before diving expeditions begin.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — AI reviews records; human observes physical procedures

dwas.name: Monitor work areas or procedures to ensure compliance with safety procedures.

tasks.text: Communicate with workers on the surface while underwater, using signal lines or telephones.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Install/repair coordination is situated teamwork

dwas.name: Communicate with coworkers to coordinate installations or repairs.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Descend into water with the aid of diver helpers, using scuba gear or diving suits.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Physical travel to sites requires human mobility

dwas.name: Travel to work sites to perform installation, repair or maintenance work.
dwas.gwa_name: Operating Vehicles, Mechanized Devices, or Equipment

tasks.text: Inspect and test docks, ships, buoyage systems, plant intakes or outflows, or underwater pipelines, cables, or sewers, using closed circuit television, still photography, and testing equipment.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — System checks partly aided by telemetry, still human-verified

dwas.name: Inspect systems to determine if they are operating properly.
Test mechanical equipment to ensure proper functioning.

tasks.text: Obtain information about diving tasks and environmental conditions.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Work conditions require physical site assessment

dwas.name: Gather information about work conditions or locations.

tasks.text: Inspect the condition of underwater steel or wood structures.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — System checks partly aided by telemetry, still human-verified

dwas.name: Inspect systems to determine if they are operating properly.

tasks.text: Operate underwater video, sonar, recording, or related equipment to investigate underwater structures or marine life.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Capturing relevant images in field is human act

dwas.name: Record images needed to address work issues.

tasks.text: Repair ships, bridge foundations, or other structures below the water line, using caulk, bolts, and hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on automotive component repair

dwas.name: Repair non-engine automotive or vehicle components.

tasks.text: Cut and weld steel, using underwater welding equipment, jigs, and supports.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual welding requires dexterity and live judgment

dwas.name: Operate welding equipment.

tasks.text: Carry out non-destructive testing, such as tests for cracks on the legs of oil rigs at sea.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on mechanical testing in physical environment

dwas.name: Test mechanical equipment to ensure proper functioning.

tasks.text: Take test samples or photographs to assess the condition of vessels or structures.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Capturing relevant images in field is human act

dwas.name: Record images needed to address work issues.

tasks.text: Supervise or train other divers, including hobby divers.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Operational training requires live human delivery

dwas.name: Train others in operational procedures.
Supervise employees.

tasks.text: Perform activities related to underwater search and rescue, salvage, recovery, or cleanup operations.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Emergency response needs physical action in the world

dwas.name: Respond to emergencies to provide assistance.

tasks.text: Recover objects by placing rigging around sunken objects, hooking rigging to crane lines, and operating winches, derricks, or cranes to raise objects.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Crane/hoist operation demands real-time physical control

dwas.name: Attach rigging to objects so they can be moved.
Operate cranes, hoists, or other moving or lifting equipment.

tasks.text: Install, inspect, clean, or repair piping or valves.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Cleaning parts for repair needs hands-on dexterity

dwas.name: Clean equipment, parts, or tools to repair or maintain them in good working order.
Install piping for installation or maintenance activities.
Repair pipes to stop leaking.

tasks.text: Set or guide placement of pilings or sandbags to provide support for structures, such as docks, bridges, cofferdams, or platforms.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Heavy structural foundation work needs hands-on construction

dwas.name: Install structural foundations.

tasks.text: Install pilings or footings for piers or bridges.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Heavy structural foundation work needs hands-on construction

dwas.name: Install structural foundations.

tasks.text: Salvage wrecked ships or their cargo, using pneumatic power velocity and hydraulic tools and explosive charges, when necessary.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Crane/hoist operation demands real-time physical control

dwas.name: Operate cranes, hoists, or other moving or lifting equipment.

tasks.text: Remove obstructions from strainers or marine railway or launching ways, using pneumatic or power hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Structural repair is hands-on physical work

dwas.name: Repair structural components.

tasks.text: Drill holes in rock and rig explosives for underwater demolitions.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Drilling parts requires physical tool operation

dwas.name: Drill holes in parts, equipment, or materials.

tasks.text: Remove rubbish or pollution from the sea.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Decontamination requires physical handling of hazards

dwas.name: Decontaminate equipment or sites to remove hazardous or toxic substances.

tasks.text: Perform offshore oil or gas exploration or extraction duties, such as conducting underwater surveys or repairing and maintaining drilling rigs or platforms.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Field survey of land/water bodies

dwas.name: Survey land or bodies of water to measure or determine features.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

dwas.name: Repair production equipment or tools.

tasks.text: Cultivate or harvest marine species or perform routine work on fish farms.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Farming equipment operation in unstructured fields

dwas.name: Harvest agricultural products.
Perform manual agricultural, aquacultural, or horticultural tasks.
Operate farming equipment.
